children: Apple is widely expected to unveil its first foldable iPhone at new Chief Executive John Ternus's first big launch event. The excitement of a shiny new gadget may well be leavened by higher prices for existing ones.

Analysts at Bank of America expect Apple to increase the prices of its Pro models by $150-$200 because of the recent runup in memory and storage costs. The iPhone 17 Pro currently costs $1,099; the 18 Pro is expected to be launched at today's event, which starts at 1 p.m. ET.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
